biography: Simon Knap, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and frustration in the Ginetta paddock, hails from the unassuming Dutch town of Zandvoort. Growing up a stone's throw from the legendary Circuit Zandvoort, Simon's fate was practically sealed at birth. His father, a former club racer, introduced him to karts at the tender age of six. Simon's natural aggression and fearless approach were evident from the start, often resulting in spectacular overtakes and the occasional trip to the gravel trap. A defining moment came during the Dutch National Karting Championship in his teens. Despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, Simon clawed his way to victory, passing ten karts on the final lap alone. This raw talent caught the eye of a Ginetta team owner, and Simon hasn't looked back since. Now at 27, Knap is considered to be at his peak, battling for podiums every weekend and aiming for the championship title he narrowly missed last season. The burning desire to prove himself as the best, and his aggressive driving style, often makes him a controversial figure. However, no one can deny his raw talent and unwavering dedication to the sport.
drivingStyle: Knap's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression'. He's known for his late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of the car and the track. While some drivers prioritize tire conservation, Knap adopts a 'maximum attack' approach from the green light, believing that gaining track position early is crucial. He possesses exceptional car control, allowing him to recover from slides and maintain momentum through corners. He is known to be particularly good in wet conditions.
rivalries: Marco Rossi: Rossi, a seasoned veteran, accuses Knap of being reckless and overly aggressive, particularly after Knap's controversial overtake at Brands Hatch last season resulted in Rossi spinning out.

Isabelle Dubois: Dubois, a rising star in the Ginetta series, views Knap as a roadblock in her path to the top. Their on-track battles are often intense, and their post-race interviews are filled with thinly veiled insults.

David Olsen: A former teammate, Olsen and Knap have a tense relationship after a disagreement about team orders during a crucial race. Olsen feels Knap prioritizes his own ambitions over the team's success.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to Dutch techno music at full volume right before getting into the car to 'pump himself up'.
Refuses to eat anything green on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Supercup race at Spa-Francorchamps in 2022, where he overtook three cars in the final corner to secure the victory in treacherous wet conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship-deciding race at Donington Park in 2023, costing him the title by a single point.
